intent: A quiet, monochrome 'Thought for 14s' card for AI replies, driven entirely by the host's model. While the model thinks it shows a live timer, one summary line that rewrites per step, and a dimmed, indented trace that the host appends to. When the reply starts the trace folds away unless the reader opened it, and the reply settles in word by word. It is a flight log, not a spinner, and it never runs its own timeline.

stack.styling: Tailwind CSS v4 (@container, arbitrary values, CSS variables for the palette)
stack.animation: motion/react (AnimatePresence mode wait for the summary, motion.li entrances) plus CSS grid-template-rows for the folds and keyframes for the header label cross-fade, word settle and the status-dot breathe

api.trace: { summary: string; detail: string; atMs?: number }[]; every step so far; the host appends
api.answer: string[] paragraphs; the host appends words as they stream
api.startedAt: number, Date.now() when thinking began; starts the live timer
api.thoughtForMs: number, final thinking time; wins over the measured time once the answer starts
api.open: boolean, controlled trace state; pair with onOpenChange; stops auto-collapse and overrides rememberChoice
api.defaultOpen: boolean, default true; open state before the reader or auto-collapse has spoken
api.autoCollapse: boolean, default true; folds the trace when the answer starts unless the reader chose
api.demo: the default export streams a scripted billing reply through the same component via a hook that is not part of the API; steps (3 to 12, default 7) and speed feed that hook
api.rememberChoice: boolean, default true; the reader's open or closed choice holds across runs in this instance; off, it lasts one run
api.storageKey: string, optional; persists the choice in localStorage (read after mount, try/catch) and implies rememberChoice

layout.root: section, @container, aria-label Reasoning; a card with 18px radius, 1px line border, padding 16px 20px (24px 28px from @md), inset top highlight and deep shadow
layout.header: flex row, min-height 44px (36px from @md), gap 12px: status dot, label, step-count button pushed right with ml-auto; button h-11 (h-9 from @md)
layout.summary: grid rows 0fr to 1fr over 300ms; inner pt-3 and min-h-[1.5em]; one line, truncates; at the hand-off the row folds and its text fades with it over 300ms (no exit slide)
layout.trace: outer grid rows 0fr to 1fr over 420ms, inner min-h-0 overflow hidden, inert when folded; ol with aria-label Reasoning steps, max-h 14rem, overflow-y auto, overscroll contain; tabIndex 0 only while the list can scroll; 1px left rule, indent 16px (20px from @md); steps are grid 1.75rem index + text (+ auto stamp column when atMs is given), gap 10px; edge fade mask built per end: top 20px once scrolled, bottom 24px while more lies below; follows the newest step while thinking
layout.reply: own fold region, grid rows 0fr to 1fr (420ms ease-out in, ease-in-out out); grows in while the trace folds so the card changes height once; a cleared reply folds and fades out (260ms ease-in, 3px blur) showing the last reply until closed; 1px top rule, 20px above and below it, paragraphs max 62ch, gap 1.1em
layout.resting: before the first run the card rests finished with its trace open and the full reply shown; it is the tallest state, so framing and screenshots include the whole card

typography.label: mono 12px, tracking 0.01em, tabular-nums, muted ink; 'Thinking ·' then ink time, then 'Thought for' then ink time; the whole label (verb, separator, digits) is one unit; on change the outgoing label stays frozen in the same grid cell and fades out (120ms ease-in, 3px blur) while the incoming fades in (200ms ease-out, 60ms delay), so there is no empty slot and the parts never disagree
typography.digits: ink, tabular-nums, one stable span updated every 100ms in place (no remount, no blur, no per-tick animation); the clock is an Elapsed child that owns its own interval and pauses offscreen and in hidden tabs; the frozen time is measured in a layout effect, never during render
typography.count: mono 12px tabular muted; 'Reasoning' before the first step, then '1 step' or 'N steps'; chevron 14px rotating 180deg
typography.summary: Geist 15px (16px from @md), line-height 1.5, tracking -0.005em, full ink
typography.steps: 13.5px line-height 1.55; index mono 11px tabular dim ink; optional stamp mono 11px tabular dim ink shown as +0.6s; latest step body ink while thinking, others dim

color.dark: surface #0d0d0f, line #26262c, ink #f4f4f5, body #d4d4d8, muted #a1a1aa, dim #8b8b95, hover rgba(255,255,255,0.06)
color.light: surface #ffffff, line #e4e4e7, ink #18181b, body #3f3f46, muted #52525b, dim #60606a, hover rgba(24,24,27,0.05)
color.accent: none. The status dot is ink while thinking and dim ink once done (200ms colour fade); no semantic colour is used for the trace

motion.demoTimeline: demo only: a run asked for holds the finished card 300ms, then folds its trace and reply away over 420ms (real time), then streams from empty. Model ms from there: lead 500 before the first step; step gap 480 times a fixed rhythm [1, .82, 1.18, .94, 1.08, .9, 1.15, .86, 1.04, .97, 1.12, .92]; answer 480ms after the last step; first words 55ms later while the trace folds; two words per tick every 55ms; done +150ms after the last word. Autoplay starts 3.6s after page load once in view; the first pointer movement starts a run at once. The demo pace divides the model times. Seven steps think for about 3.8s
motion.steps: each step rises 6px out of a 4px blur over 320ms, once, on mount; steps mounting in the same render stagger 50ms in reading order (cap 8)
motion.summary: AnimatePresence mode wait: exit 6px up over 140ms, then enter 6px rise from 3px blur over 260ms
motion.words: each reply word settles from a 3px blur over 320ms (keyframe ai-rt-word), once, on arrival
motion.fold: summary row, trace region and reply region all grid-template-rows (300ms, 420ms, 420ms); at the hand-off the reply grows while the trace folds, so the height changes once
motion.clock: real elapsed time, Date.now() minus startedAt, updated every 100ms by Elapsed while thinking; measured time frozen at the hand-off unless thoughtForMs is given
motion.ambient: status dot breathes (opacity 0.45 to 1, 1.6s, alternating) in ink while thinking and rests in dim ink otherwise; nothing else loops
motion.reducedMotion: states still arrive as they happen; steps, words and the summary use 150ms opacity fades only; no blur, rise, breathe, fold or smooth scroll; the demo does not autoplay and shows the finished card

responsive.all: designed from 320px to 1920px; the card follows its container width via @container; the demo stage is top-anchored so the header never moves
responsive.narrow: summary truncates; step text wraps; header stays one line; trace caps its height and scrolls; padding and indent step up at @md

accessibility: step-count control is a button with aria-expanded, aria-controls pointing at the trace region, and aria-label Show or Hide reasoning; the count is included only once a step has landed
button is 44px tall on mobile and 36px from @md; focus-visible draws a 2px ink ring with 2px offset, immediately, keyboard only
folded trace is inert so nothing inside is reachable
trace list is keyboard scrollable (tabIndex 0) only while it can scroll, with an inset focus ring
visually hidden role=status with aria-live polite speaks the first step, then at most one summary every 5 seconds, then Thought for 2.7s once the reply starts
the live summary line is not itself a live region and is aria-hidden once thinking ends, to avoid announcing every step

aria-busy marks only the step list while thinking and the reply while it streams; the section is never busy, and the role=status region sits outside every busy region so its polite announcements are spoken
section has aria-label Reasoning; trace list has aria-label Reasoning steps; dots and chevrons are aria-hidden

content.question: Why did the invoice jump when I added two seats mid-cycle?
content.steps: 12 reasoning steps in the demo, each with a one-line summary and a detail line, about proration, day counting, pricing two seats at $24 for 11 of 30 days ($17.60), the renewal line, duplicate and tax checks and tone; the demo streams seven by default
content.answer: Two paragraphs: proration, not a double charge, with the $17.60 figure; then the renewal line that can sit beside it

avoid: purple or rainbow gradients and gradient text
a progress bar that pretends to know the duration
an infinite pulse on content (only the status dot breathes)
folding the reply away with the trace
a timeline inside the component: the host's model owns timing
